title: Link App Configuration Registry
description: Enumerates all required application configuration keys needed to run the system in any deployed environment.

global.description: Configurations shared across most or all services.

description.description: A brief explanation of what the setting does and why it is required.

required.description: Whether the setting is strictly required for the service to start/function correctly.

global.description: Comma-separated list of Kafka bootstrap servers for event messaging.
The type of database provider to use (e.g., SqlServer, MongoDB).
The connection string for the primary service database.
The OIDC authority URL used for validating bearer tokens.
The authority URL used by the LinkTokenService for internal token generation and validation.
The secret key used for signing internal tokens. Must be kept secure.
Boolean flag to enable or disable OpenTelemetry tracing and metrics.
The endpoint URI for the Grafana Loki log aggregator.
The connection string for the Redis cache (e.g., 'localhost:6379,password=...').
The connection string for the internal Azure Blob Storage (or Azurite).
The name of the blob container used for internal storage.

Account.description: The base URL for the Tenant Service.

AdminBFF.description: The base URL for the Account Service used by the BFF.
The OAuth2 client ID for the Admin BFF.
The OAuth2 client secret for the Admin BFF.
The backend address for each service routed through the BFF (e.g., AccountService, AuditService, etc.).

Census.description: Comma-separated list of FHIR Observation codes used to identify census events.

DataAcquisition.description: The cron expression defining how often data acquisition jobs should run.
The base URL for the Tenant Service used to validate facilities.

MeasureEval.description: Kafka bootstrap servers for the measure evaluation service.
The base URL for the Report Service.
The OIDC authority URL for token validation.
The connection string for blob storage used for internal data.
The name of the blob container for internal measure data.

Normalization.description: The base URL for the Tenant Service.

Notification.description: The base URL for the Tenant Service.
The SMTP server hostname for sending notifications.

QueryDispatch.description: The base URL for the Tenant Service.

Report.description: The base URL for the Tenant Service.
The connection string for the internal Azure Blob Storage (or Azurite).
The name of the blob container used for internal storage.

Submission.description: The base URL for the Report Service.
The local or network path where submission files are stored.
The connection string for the internal Azure Blob Storage (or Azurite).
The name of the blob container used for internal storage.
The connection string for the external Azure Blob Storage (where submissions are stored).
The name of the blob container used for external storage.

Tenant.description: The base URL for the Measure Service (if applicable).

Terminology.description: The path to the terminology data files.
